name: MerchantSpring
description:
MerchantSpring is the marketplace analytics platform built for agencies and enterprise brands, unifying sales, profit, advertising, inventory, traffic, Buy Box, and customer performance across seller and vendor accounts on 120+ marketplaces including Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and more.

This connector puts all of it inside Claude. Ask questions in plain language and Claude pulls live, portfolio-wide metrics with period-on-period comparisons built in. Drill from the total portfolio down to a single store or SKU, covering sales trends, store and product-level profit and loss, advertising performance by channel, and 16 on-demand report types spanning inventory health, Buy Box performance, traffic and conversion, customer lifetime value, refunds, and repeat purchase.

Ask things like "Compare sales across all client marketplaces this month vs last", "Which SKUs ran negative margins last quarter?", "How did advertising performance shift across channels week on week?", or "Show ordered vs shipped revenue for our Amazon Vendor accounts by month". Claude fetches the live numbers and does the analysis on the spot.

For agencies, that means the whole client book in one conversation - filter any query by marketplace, country, or store tags, compare performance across every account you manage, and turn the answers straight into client-ready reporting. Seller and vendor accounts are both fully supported.

Trusted by 35,000+ brands and agencies.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MerchantSpring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MerchantSpring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.merchantspring.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MerchantSpring MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MerchantSpring lists 13 MCP tools, including calculateDateEpoch, generateReport, getAdvertisingByChannels, getChannels, getProductProfitAndLoss, getReportStatus, getSalesByChannels, getSalesByPeriod, getSalesByProduct, getStoreProfitAndLoss, getVendorSalesByPeriod, and readSummarizedReport.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MerchantSpring?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MerchantSpring in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
MerchantSpring requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MerchantSpring is developed by MerchantSpring. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
